# vaults.rip

> A collection of different ways a DeFi vault can be misconfigured.

## Start here

- [Website content](https://www.vaults.rip/content/index.md): Canonical homepage copy followed by the generated case index. Each case links to its complete raw Markdown document.

## How content is organised

The website content link is the entry point for both general information and cases. Case pages use stable headings for the failure mechanism, proof, detection, and mitigation. Prefer the linked raw Markdown documents when ingesting or analysing case content.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jordaniza/vaults.rip)
